worksheet.arithmetic: Missing-usage bound per request = (input cap x $1.25 + output cap x $5) / 1,000,000. Charge each admitted request including failures and retries within its cap. Requests cannot be renewed; no retry outside allocation.
worksheet.acquisition: Three preassigned normal-menu profile slots, one new world/survivor each, default game rules/difficulty. Record visible setup choices and first-play identity/time/location, then accept the first result. Each slot allows up to24 creation requests,4 save/load-check requests and2 cleanup requests (including failures). If a desired visible contrast is absent, retain the source with its actual labels and report the uncovered profile; never reroll for preferred traits. Stop on failure or allocation exhaustion; no replacements or renewal. Source setup/cleanup native and human durations and any infrastructure costs are unknown. Extra requests are outside this priced scope, not an available allowance.
worksheet.coverage_note: Twelve sources are a prospective coverage target only, not a sample size or authorization.
worksheet.assignment: Freeze source identity and parent, assign each independent world to all three arms with equivalent corresponding role settings; group continuations, moments and repeats within world/lineage.
worksheet.estimator: Proposed later all-assigned binary visible task-progress bundle AND alive at the finite request/wall endpoint; exact source predicates and reader qualification are frozen after feasibility, before final collection. Dead or failed-start outcomes are0 in the primary; ambiguous/censored visible outcomes remain unknown with0/1 bounds, and technical failures get a separate unknown sensitivity. Average sources equally within each profile then average profiles equally; compare arms by paired source, cluster uncertainty by entire world/lineage, nest moments/repeats within it, and include full search repeats if later claimed. Never condition on use or count copies as independent. Report displayed game-time intervals and censoring, and travel only with visible landmark/map support; no pixel-distance proxy.
worksheet.calibration: After source feasibility, #681 qualifies independent visible readers on positive, negative and unknown examples and distinguishes structural impossibility from rare zeros. Simulate the exact paired all-assigned estimator with source clustering, repeat/search variance and censoring before sizing; no old withholding power forecast. #677 reuses these packets.
worksheet.current_interface: Current fact/article publication and delivered-knowledge/1 do not carry arbitrary schemas. This is an inert research worksheet, not a scheduler or production integration.

Curator and search 65536 / 8192 ($0.12288), judge 32768 / 4096 ($0.06144) are proposed caps. Wall is 300 seconds per request; role/stage sums are upper bounds, not measured duration.

worksheet.scope: Computed model-rate bounds price two finite proposed stages separately and jointly, including all role attempts/failures/retries and reserved ending/acquisition calls. These are conservative configured-price bounds, not measured expected spend or a complete approval-ready pilot while feasibility, unqualified outcomes, unsupported arbitrary-schema live integration and non-provider costs remain unresolved.
